a.lede: From high-profile Senate races to local rezoning initiatives, data centers and their supporters did miserably on the ballot in the 2026 midterms.
a.title: The Results Are In: Voters Hate Data Centers

b.lede: A new website seeks to distill over 10,000 public comments about data centers in the community across more than 410 local governments, and the consensus is that people don't like them one bit.
b.title: 'America hates data centers' — New data highlights public sentiment
